body.text: Zero-Collateral Borrowing in a Single Block

In traditional finance, borrowing $50 million requires posting substantial collateral, undergoing weeks of credit underwriting, and signing legal contracts. In decentralized finance, a flash loan allows anyone to borrow $100 million instantly with zero upfront collateral—under the ironclad condition that the principal plus a small fee (typically 0.09%) is returned within the very same atomic transaction.

items: State Reversion Guarantee: If the borrower fails to repay the full loan amount by the end of transaction execution, the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM) reverts all state changes as if the transaction never happened.
Zero Default Risk: Lenders (such as Aave or MakerDAO) take zero credit risk because uncollateralized funds never leave the smart contract ecosystem unpaid.
Cross-DEX Arbitrage: Exploiting price discrepancies between Uniswap, Sushiswap, and Curve pools instantaneously without tying up personal capital.
Collateral Swapping & Self-Liquidation: Enabling underwater borrowers to swap out sinking debt collateral or close troubled loan positions in one click.

body.text: Flash loans democratize market liquidity: capital access is no longer gated by balance sheet size, but purely by the algorithmic correctness of your smart contract code.

body.text: Mev Bots and Mempool Priority Gas Auctions

Because flash loan arbitrage opportunities are public, thousands of MEV (Maximal Extractable Value) searcher bots scan the public mempool simultaneously. Searchers compete in Priority Gas Auctions (PGAs) and private Flashbots bundles, bidding away up to 90% of trade profits to block validators to guarantee atomic execution.
